products.name: NAUTILUS BCAA - Lemon - 450 GM
products.shortDescription: Recover Faster. Train Harder. No Muscle Loss. Essential 2:1:1 BCAA formula with 45 servings of pure muscle recovery, zero sugar, and refreshing natural tangy lemon flavor.
products.description:
Nautilus BCAA is essential for every gym boy. When you train hard, your muscles break. BCAA stops that breakage. With 2:1:1 Ratio of Leucine, Isoleucine, Valine, it helps you recover fast, reduces muscle soreness, and keeps you energetic during workout.

Delicious natural Lemon flavor - No bitter taste. Instant Mix.

Product At a Glance:
• Brand: Nautilus Protein
• Product: BCAA (Branched Chain Amino Acids)
• Quantity: 450 GM
• Flavor: Lemon (Tangy Lemon)
• Servings: 45 Servings (approx. 10g per serving)
• Ratio: 2:1:1 (Leucine: Isoleucine: Valine)
• Goal: Muscle Recovery, Anti-Catabolic, Endurance
ingredients: Branched Chain Amino Acids (L-Leucine, L-Isoleucine, L-Valine)
products.directions:
Mix 1 scoop (10g) with 250-300ml cold water.
• Intra-Workout (Best): Sip during workout for endurance.
• Post-Workout: Take immediately after workout for recovery.
• Morning: Take on rest days to prevent muscle loss.
Take 1-2 servings per day. Drink at least 3 liters of water daily.
products.warnings:
Food Supplement Only. Not a Medicine. Not for under 18 years. Do not exceed 20g per day. Consult doctor if pregnant or have medical condition. Contains sweetener - contains no sugar.
Storage: Store in cool, dry place below 30°C. Keep tightly closed. Keep away from moisture. Do not refrigerate. Shelf Life: 18 Months.
Manufactured For: Nautilus Protein, A Project of Nautilus Pharma, Karachi, Pakistan
products.headline: Recover Faster. Train Harder. No Muscle Loss.
highlights: Fast Recovery: Reduces muscle soreness (DOMS) after workout. You can train daily without pain.
Stops Muscle Breakdown: Anti-catabolic formula. Protects your muscle during cutting, fasting, or long workouts.
More Strength & Endurance: Leucine triggers muscle protein synthesis. Train longer without fatigue.
450 GM Full Size: Not 200gm. Full 45 servings for 45 days. Best value for money in Pakistan.

faqs.question: Is BCAA a steroid?
faqs.answer: No. BCAA is natural amino acid found in chicken, eggs, milk. 100% safe and legal.

faqs.question: Difference between BCAA and Protein?
faqs.answer: Protein builds muscle. BCAA protects and recovers muscle. Best to use both.

faqs.question: Can I take BCAA with Creatine or Mass Gainer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Perfect stack: Mass Gainer + BCAA + Creatine = Fast Gain + Fast Recovery.

faqs.question: Will it damage kidney?
faqs.answer: No, when used as directed (1-2 scoops/day) with enough water. No side effects.

faqs.question: Does it contain caffeine?
faqs.answer: No. No caffeine, no jitters. You can sleep after taking it.
